content:
Programming Language Reference: SQL (Structured Query Language)
Version: ISO/IEC 9075:2023 (SQL:2023)
Syntax: Declarative domain-specific language for managing and querying data in relational database management systems (RDBMS).
Semantics: Relational algebra operations (selection, projection, join, set operations), ACID transaction semantics.
Type System: Static schema typing (INT, VARCHAR, DECIMAL, TIMESTAMP, JSON, BOOLEAN, ARRAY).
Memory Model: Database buffer pool management, page-based table storage, Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) for durability.
Concurrency: Multi-Version Concurrency Control (MVCC), transaction isolation levels (Read Committed, Repeatable Read, Serializable).
Error Handling: SQLSTATE error codes, transaction rollback via ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT.
Standard APIs: DDL (CREATE, ALTER, DROP), DML (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE), DQL (SELECT), DCL (GRANT, REVOKE)
Specification: ISO/IEC 9075 Standard
Official Docs: https://www.iso.org/standard/76583.html
